scheme_name: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Aarthik Kalyan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution such as MFI, NBFC, SFB, or PACS
Applicant must not be a current beneficiary of any other self‑employment scheme from the state or central government
Family income definition: if unmarried, includes applicant and dependent parents; if married, includes applicant, spouse, and dependent children (no age limit for dependent, unmarried children)
benefits_summary: 7% interest subsidy on loans for up to 5 years.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
